sourceTitle: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), Official Journal text (Publications Office); amendments checked in Regulation (EU) 2026/1744
note: Citation kept; question and L5 reworded, and the second citation 'EU NIS2 Art. 21(2)(j)' was removed. Art. 13 is a design duty for high-risk systems: operation transparent enough for deployers to interpret output and use it appropriately, with instructions for use; it is not a duty to explain decisions to the public. NIS2 Art. 21(2)(j) covers multi-factor authentication and secured communications, which has nothing to do with decision transparency, and no other NIS2 clause sets that duty, so it was removed.
